# hacienda - Java Bindings

Bindings for hacienda

## Installation

Add to your `pom.xml`:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.jamon8888</groupId>
    <artifactId>hacienda</artifactId>
    <version>0.1.0</version>
</dependency>
```

## Quick Start

```java
import com.github.jamon8888.*;

// See https://github.com/jamon8888/hacienda-engine for usage examples.
```

## Documentation

For full documentation, see the [hacienda repository](https://github.com/jamon8888/hacienda-engine).
